text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 176 Berry Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 13, 2024) for 176 Berry Road, Folder Number 24 196928 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 1, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City
